Good to have you all here. I'm going to try and get a rough draft together as a starting point for what this group would be focusing on with respect to sync. I'll be aiming to have this not be anchored to any specific client implementation details or sync algorithm. I plan on bringing this up on the next call, but it makes sense to have other calls be on an off week for the main stateless one. So probably 2-3 weeks from now on Tuesday I am thinking. Depending on progress and interest from the group Would an inaugural call help before we have some of this information fleshed out about group goals and such? Maybe, but I would prefer to enter that call with some basic group understanding of the goals and direction (which we call solidify during the call) Let’s add that to the agenda 👌
